prompt_delta: Generate one square, white-background, crisp monochrome pixel-ink source-art sheet containing exactly six complete, centered V9 Companion everyday emotion poses in a clean unlabelled 3 by 2 grid with generous separation and equal empty margins. The six poses are Calm, Curious, Warm, Playful, Puzzled, and Alert. Every pose must be unmistakably the same locked V9 character: identical pair of open rounded black eyes, identical eye size and spacing, identical white primary highlight plus one tiny fixed sparkle per eye, identical small centered nose, and the same black-on-white low-detail pixel-ink language. Make the emotional reads genuinely distinct through the specified brow geometry, mouth shape, cheek response, gaze emphasis, and only a tiny integrated source-ink context detail for Playful. Calm is neutral and quiet; Curious has one brow slightly raised and a small wondering mouth; Warm has softer brows, a visibly warmer upturned mouth and fuller cheeks; Playful has buoyant brows, a clear small asymmetric grin, lively cheeks and one tiny integrated sparkle; Puzzled has one high brow, one compressed brow, an offset thinking mouth and sideward attention; Alert has lifted inward brows, a compact round surprise mouth and raised attention without punctuation. This is source art for later component extraction, not a UI screenshot, an animation frame, a set of cards, or a final runtime screen.
